title: Video-HopChain: Multi-Hop Questions and Confidence-Gated Exploration for Video Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.25773v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: HopChain has shown on still images that multi-hop data synthesis improves vision-language reasoning, because long chain-of-thought reasoning exposes errors that compound across steps, while most data used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) rarely demands a chain of visual evidence, so these weaknesses are likely to stay unexposed. We observe the same problem in video, where this framework has not yet been explored. We therefore build Video-HopChain, a dataset of 22,550 multi-hop video questions over 13,378 videos, together with a held-out benchmark of 1,000 questions. Each question chains three to six yes/no questions about moments in one video, and each yields one of two integers depending on its answer. The final answer is the sum of these integers, so an exact match on that sum gives the verifiable reward that RLVR needs. translated_title: Video-HopChain：面向视频推理模型的多跳问题与置信度门控探索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.25773v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：HopChain 已在静态图像上证明，多跳数据合成能够改善视觉-语言推理，因为长思维链推理会暴露那些随步骤不断累积的错误，而大多数用于可验证奖励强化学习的数据很少要求一条视觉证据链，因此这些弱点很可能得不到暴露。我们在视频领域观察到了同样的问题，而该框架尚未在视频领域被探索过。为此，我们构建了 Video-HopChain，这是一个基于 13,378 个视频、包含 22,550 个多跳视频问题的数据集，并附带一个由 1,000 个问题组成的留存基准测试集。每个问题将关于同一视频中若干时刻的三到六个是非题串联起来，且每个是非题根据其答案产生两个整数中的一个。最终答案是这些整数之和，因此对该和的精确匹配即可提供 RLVR 所需的可验证奖励。我们首先在标准视频数据集上使用 GRPO 训练 Qwen3-VL-8B，随后进行第二次……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Video-HopChain，首次将多跳问题合成引入视频领域，通过串联三到六个是非题并以整数之和作为可精确验证的最终答案，构建了含 22,550 个多跳视频问题及基准的数据集，为视频推理模型的 RLVR 训练提供长视觉证据链并暴露累积性推理错误。
en_tdlr: Video-HopChain introduces multi-hop video question synthesis with sum-based verifiable rewards—22,550 questions over 13,378 videos plus a 1,000-question benchmark—to expose compounding reasoning errors and improve RLVR training for video reasoning models.
